title: Delete dead LearningOrderPreferences singleton (superseded by ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys)
rule: dead code + SM-7 (no global/static mutable singletons)
why: This 34-line hand-rolled singleton duplicates the parent-controls-ordering flag that parentControlsOrderingProvider now reads from ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys (learning_order_providers.dart:70-77), a profile-scoped replacement. LearningOrderPreferences is not profile-scoped (one global bool for every profile on the device) and has zero references anywhere in lib/ or test/; if it were wired back in by mistake it would reintroduce both the SM-7 singleton anti-pattern and a cross-profile setting bug.
recommendation: Delete the file now that ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys is the live implementation.
acceptance_criteria: File removed; no dangling references in lib/ or test/
